AKSHAR

THE COLLEGE MAGAZINE

AKSHAR, the college magazine of UIT-RGPV is a leaf book of live-literature and tele-technical ideas. As the motto says "Aspiration To Zenith", Akshar inspires you to reach the best of you, by providing you a platform to express your views, enlighten yourself with experiences of successful personalities and gives you a chance to unravel your hidden talents publicly. It brings to you a unique blend of technical as well as non-technical aspects of our engineering college. We aim to provide the readers with quality content that they can enjoy and to give blooming talented minds the spotlight and appreciation that they deserve.

Industrial Insights

Popping into the culture of industries: Ever thought about real life implementation of all that you're taught in engineering? We bring to you“Industrial insight”,a brief of how bookish technology is put into action.Akshar provides you to the much-needed exposure to the complex world of industries. Get along with us on an exciting trip to industries.Akshar will help you know about the real work done in industries and help you utilize your resources mindfully.

Artwork

Bored from college studies? Does art soothe your burning soul? Are you an art lover? If you answer yes to any of these questions, then you're gonna love the new art section of Akshar. Art is just not limited to the expression of one's imagination and skill but it is a depiction of a person’s unbounded thoughts shaping a whole new world. Henceforth dive deep into a world full of fascination and imagery.

Survey

Do you want to have a peep into what goes in the life of a student at UIT RGPV. We present to you an insight into a Student's journey from a novice to an all-rounder (Engineer) with surveys conducted on witty topics. You will know about student's secret hideouts, innumerable bunks, last moment submissions, profound seniors and many more.So gear up fellas because Akshar is going to conduct the survey among students on their college experience.

CONNECT
